faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about establishing yourself in Paraguay

items.question: What exactly does the program include?
items.answer: Residency, national ID, company formation, tax registration (RUC), business bank account coordination, document pre-validation, one-day operational procedure with exclusive driver and transfers, strategic real estate tour, and full technical advisory. Fees, VAT, and official migration taxes are included.

items.question: How long does the entire process take?
items.answer: The initial document validation takes 1–2 weeks. The operative day in Asunción takes one morning. Company formation and RUC registration: 2–4 weeks after. Bank account opening: 2–4 weeks. Full delivery: approximately 45–60 days from your trip.

items.question: Do I need to be physically present in Paraguay?
items.answer: Yes, for one day. All in-person procedures (residency application, ID, notary) are completed in a single morning. Before and after that, everything is handled remotely.

items.question: What is the difference between the two programs?
items.answer: Paraguay Business (USD 4,400) covers establishment: residency, company, bank account. Paraguay Investor Program (USD 6,900) adds 12 months of company accounting, legal and tax advisory, and investment analysis with direct access to our team.

items.question: Is the bank account guaranteed?
items.answer: We prepare and coordinate the complete banking dossier. While we cannot guarantee approval (this depends on each bank's internal policies), our pre-validation process and existing bank relationships result in a very high success rate.

items.question: What documents do I need from my country?
items.answer: Birth certificate, criminal record certificate, marriage certificate (if applicable), passport, proof of address. All documents must be apostilled in your country of origin. We provide a detailed checklist and pre-validate everything before you travel.

items.question: Do I need to speak Spanish?
items.answer: No. Our team handles all procedures in Spanish and communicates with you in your language. All translations within Paraguay are handled by us.

items.question: Can my family be included?
items.answer: Family residency is possible but is handled as a separate process with additional government fees. We coordinate family procedures and provide specific guidance during your consultation.

items.question: What happens after the program ends?
items.answer: For Business clients, you receive all documents and operate independently. For Investor clients, you continue with 12 months of accounting, legal advisory, and investment support. Renewal services are available separately.

items.question: Is the residency permanent?
items.answer: You initially receive temporary residency, which converts to permanent residency. The timeline and conditions are determined by Paraguayan migration authorities. We handle the entire process.

items.question: Do you provide tax advice for my home country?
items.answer: No. We provide advisory on Paraguayan tax and legal matters only. For tax implications in your country of residence, we recommend consulting a local tax professional. We can coordinate with your advisors.

items.question: What if a procedure is denied?
items.answer: Government denials are extremely rare when documentation is properly prepared (which is our core function). If a bank denies account opening, we work with alternative banking partners. Our pre-validation process minimizes this risk.

items.question: How is payment structured?
items.answer: Full payment is required before services begin, via bank transfer. This covers all professional fees, VAT, government taxes, and administrative costs within Paraguay. No additional charges for the standard program.

items.question: What is NOT included in the price?
items.answer: International flights, accommodation, personal expenses, sworn translations in your home country, apostilles/legalizations in your home country, additional legal services beyond the program scope, and post-program renewals.

items.question: Why Paraguay specifically?
items.answer: Paraguay offers a competitive tax system (10% income tax, territorial system), a growing economy with controlled inflation, a low cost of living, favorable investment conditions, and a straightforward residency process for foreigners. It is one of the most accessible countries for European entrepreneurs seeking operational establishment.
